method: Read-only inspection of frozen client sources, wrappers, selected driver accounting and certificate accessors; no Cargo, numerical execution, published-proof revalidation, or source mutation.

checks.claim: Polynomial and diagonal output is requested-endpoint-only; nonlinear homotopy is endpoint-only; actual-K is stage-functional-only with ode_truncation_certified=false; allocation is algebraic-only; only sealed generic provider/replay marks full_curve_certified=true.

Case fixture inputs and budgets are independent of selected arm. CLI has no budget/input override. Request hashes use common represented-bit payloads and intentionally exclude arm/thread. Explicit schedule choices differ only by selected arm and are exported.

Global replay uses unchanged native run and source atol; validates exact run identity; returns original solver/provider and extra replay work on refusal. Provider maximum includes both continuous uniform radii and stored-query center radii.
Diagonal endpoint oracle uses outward exp at exactly represented dyadic exponent and outward original-IVP L2 displacement; stage targets are explicitly marked used_by_driver=false.

Polynomial named arms state guarded fallback semantics; selected backend and fallback status are exported. Krylov convergence does not confer accuracy authority; independent original-IVP endpoint enclosure does.

Allocation 32-vs40 is a validated algebraic work ceiling at same budget, explicitly actual_ode_steps_executed=0. Heuristic plan cost is separately reported and timed, not silently substituted for supplied exact counts.

Outer elapsed includes setup, all call/retry work, certificate and output materialization; process/threadpool startup and final serialization exclusions are explicit. Homotopy/actual-K coupled certificate timer is null rather than invented. Native work is not labeled complete FLOPs; scheduler span and allocated bytes remain unknown; speed promotion remains HOLD.

limitations: Source-review PASS does not replace final native matrix or paired NCP execution.

Request hash alone is not a cross-version executable identity: default solver/router/planner policy fields are source-defined and not all copied into request JSON. Pair only under the source/binary identity captured by the outer benchmark receipt.

Diagonal fallback_count sums forced/contraction/budget/staleness refresh reasons. Initial refreshes (including recovery after unusable state) and rejected attempts are separate native ledgers; do not read this field as an exhaustive universal retry count.
Fixed fixture checks establish no general-purpose production speed, arbitrary-callback global accuracy, or actual scheduler span.

The reviewer implemented global_budget provider/allocator changes, but did not author these client drivers; this is independent integration/scope review, not an independent re-proof of the underlying mathematics.
